reason: Our whole business runs on billable hours per client, and nothing in this pitch says it tracks time at all. A nice client page doesn't help me if I still have to log hours somewhere else and reconcile them.
objection: No per-client time tracking, so it can't tell me which projects are overrunning or what to invoice, which is the actual problem I have.
would_change_my_mind: Built-in time tracking per client and per task, with estimate vs actual and an export I can invoice from.
